# Local duplicate support diagnostic

The ordinary assertion WF path already ends with whole-proposition can-call
support. Test only omission of the additional identical leading support command,
after certified pure preparation has commuted it to that exact point. Both native
structural expression equality and the strict lexical fingerprint must agree;
attributes must be absent. Keep every original preparation command once, all
distinct terms/fuel, the sole actual check/full metadata, publication and transfers.

No expression or translator traversal is skipped. No body/context application
collector is used. Target names select the bounded audit, not support generation.
Require faithful native full-query/resource/outcome controls, strict actual check
comparisons and genuine Invalid entry controls. This scratch experiment is not
an adopted product change or positive proof acceptance.
